# WooCommerce

Stores and marketplaces · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**WooCommerce publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

WooCommerce's two published skills are developer tools (an Abilities API guide and a stale-PR audit); both are indexed by owner decision. For store data, WooCommerce publishes WooCommerce for Claude (woocommerce/woocommerce-claude), which is indexed, on top of WordPress's official MCP Adapter.

## What to use

### From WooCommerce

- **[WooCommerce for Claude](../../skills/woocommerce-for-claude/README.md)** — Plugin · Only reads; changes nothing · needs WooCommerce store (8.0+) with the plugin installed · [source](https://github.com/woocommerce/woocommerce-claude/tree/trunk)
  WooCommerce's own plugin that turns a store into an MCP endpoint for Claude: revenue, orders, refunds, coupons, tax and product analytics from WooCommerce's analytics tables, plus workflow skills such as failed-order triage and payment-method review.
- **[WooCommerce Abilities API implement](../../skills/wc-abilities-api-implement/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs a WooCommerce extension codebase · [source](https://github.com/woocommerce/agent-skills/tree/trunk/skills/abilities-api-implement)
  WooCommerce's developer skill for registering WordPress Abilities API capabilities in a WooCommerce extension.
- **[WooCommerce stale PR audit](../../skills/wc-stale-pr-audit/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs a cohort of WooCommerce pull requests · [source](https://github.com/woocommerce/agent-skills/tree/trunk/skills/woocommerce-stale-pr-audit)
  WooCommerce's maintainer skill for reviewing stale pull requests in WooCommerce's own repository.
- **[WordPress MCP Adapter](../../skills/wordpress-mcp-adapter/README.md)** — MCP server · Changes records without asking first · needs a WordPress site with abilities registered and marked public · [source](https://github.com/WordPress/mcp-adapter/tree/trunk)
  The official WordPress package that exposes a site's registered abilities as MCP tools.
